display_long_description:
**Your first four waves are free.**

This demo gives you the opening of Purple Mars, in runs of up to 4:44, as often as you like. Finish four waves, then see how fast you can do it again. Your best time waits on the title screen.

**Point. Pull. Fly.**

Aim your hand where you want to be and squeeze. Feather the trigger to drift; bury it to tear across the sky. No plane to wrestle, no inertia to fight, no altitude you're stuck at.

**Fly among the swarm.**

Cube-built robots pace, evade, chase and taunt all around you: above, below and behind. Climb over them, drop beneath them, or hang still and let the swarm come.

**Aggression is power.**

Kills, combos and loot feed your momentum, and your weapon answers in kind: one bolt becomes a spreading circle of seven, faster and wilder the harder you push. Coast, and it drains away.

**Fly the bomb as well.**

One hand holds you in the air; the other steers a live bomb through the swarm. It waits for your grip. Time it right and the shockwave takes the whole gang at once.

**Break beautiful things.**

Every enemy is built from cubes and dies like it. One clean hit to the eye and the whole thing bursts apart, every block flung with the speed it was carrying. Then chase the wreckage down too, if you can.

**Sixteen waves. One planet. Your best run.**

The full game takes you through all sixteen waves, all the way to the win. When four waves aren't enough, it's waiting for you.
